english.title: Occupier of slaughterhouse fail to comply with TSE monitoring requirements to take / facilitate taking of samples
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..), failed to take samples or facilitate the taking of samples by an inspector, as required by the Secretary of State's TSE monitoring requirements in Annex 3 of the EU TSE Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(5) and 18(1)(a) and (2) of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018.
